comment: The design of the mitering UI test (mitcad#1940; tools/ui-build-end-meets-test.sh): two profiles placed apart meeting in an L. Upright (C1, Upright:1 O1, its derived part F1), the test library's 20 mm square profile (LIBRARY_URL, replaced by the test) placed by BUILD standing at the origin, 500 long; Arm (C2, Arm:1 O2, its derived part F2, its body F2.b0, its slider joint F3), the same profile 300 long on the upright's y+ side from end A at offset 480, so that its top is flush with the upright's end B (z = 480 to 500) and its end A stands on the side at y = 10. Both ends square. All geometry is synthetic.
